एक फल। दो भाई। One fruit, two brothers, and a race around the world 🥭🦚🔊

Kartikeya flew around the world on his peacock. Ganesha walked three times around his parents and said: you are my world.

Sometimes winning isn't about going far. It's about looking closer. Spend a little more time today with the people who are your world.

Which version did you grow up with? 👇
In the Shiva Purana, the race decides which brother marries first. In Tamil Nadu it is a fruit of knowledge brought by Narada, and when Kartikeya leaves for the hills, Shiva and Parvati follow him and say "pazham nee", you are the fruit. That is how Palani is said to get its name.
